ModMetaData.name: Fix - WRMegaCorp Quest Reward Multiplier
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiver (local patch)
ModMetaData.description: Initializes the missing $questRewardMultiplier slate variable in WRMegaCorp's WRMC_MeatOrder, WRMC_DepositExploitation and WRMC_ProjectLiquidation quest scripts. Without it, SlateRef treats the variable as 0, which zeroes the quest reward value and logs "Tried to use variable questRewardMultiplier in a math expression but it doesn't exist." every time natural quests are rolled. Value is set to 1 (no behavior change beyond restoring the intended multiplier).
